responsibilities.description: Works out the reporting period. If no start is given it uses the Monday of the current week, and if no end is given it uses six days after the start. It rejects a period whose end comes before its start.

evidence.quote: if (end < start) throw new DomainError("validation", "to must not be before from");

responsibilities.name: Compute per-session sales, hire income and refunds

responsibilities.description: Marks each session as held or cancelled because of ice, based on its status and ice-hold flag.

responsibilities.description: Adds up the per-session rows into weekly totals: tickets, members, refunds, hire income by size, ice-affected sessions, and overall occupancy.
